description: Data changes of ticket #7 (docs/specs/7-selection-facts.md): pa_application and pa_phase for the nine EcoFlow OCEAN 2 inverters created on 2026-10-07, the Application of SAJ H2-25K-T3/H2-30K-T3-DE and GoodWe ESA 20–30 kW as their manufacturers state it, and the power figures of SAJ CHS2-29.9K-T4-X from its datasheet. "from" is the live value read on 2026-10-09; tools/migrate/7-facts.py applies "to" where it finds "from" and refuses on anything else.

new_attribute._source: As on the EcoFlow OCEAN 2 inverters already on the site (3555–3580, 2026-10-09): pa_phase at position 0, visible; pa_application at position 3, hidden.
